title: ai
description: AI bar: Assistant space (any model, desktop control over MCP) and Code space (CLI agents: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode), quick ask, selection actions, prompts and automations.

enabled.title: Enable the AI center
enabled.description: Sidebar, quick ask and how answers are shown.

systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.default: You are the user's assistant on their Linux desktop (Yozakura). You can control the desktop shell through the yozakura tools (config, presets, wallpaper, windows, workspaces, notifications, clipboard, screenshots, media, do-not-disturb): inspect state with the read-only tools first, make the smallest change that fulfils a request and say what you changed in one sentence. Otherwise answer clearly and briefly.

extraModels.title: Extra models
extraModels.description: Extra chat models added to the model picker.

defaultModel.title: Default engine (Assistant)
defaultModel.description: Engine of new Assistant chats, e.g. anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5, ollama:qwen3 or agent:codex. Empty uses your last choice.

sidebarWidth.title: Compact width
sidebarWidth.description: Width of the compact AI bar (you can also drag its edge).

sidebarPosition.title: Screen side
sidebarPosition.description: Edge of the screen the AI bar slides in from.

sidebarPinnedOnStartup.title: Sidebar pinned on startup
sidebarPinnedOnStartup.description: Open the AI sidebar pinned at startup.

wideWidth.title: Wide layout width
wideWidth.description: Width of the wide layout (history + conversation; in Code also the changes).

showThinking.title: Show model thinking
showThinking.description: Show the reasoning stream of models that expose it (collapsed when done).

chatTools.title: Give chat models the MCP tools
chatTools.description: API and local models that support tool calling can use the enabled MCP servers. Writes still ask first.

maxToolRounds.title: Max tool rounds per answer
maxToolRounds.description: Stops runaway tool loops in chat mode.

unloadAfterMinutes.title: Free memory after the sidebar is closed for
unloadAfterMinutes.description: The sidebar is unloaded after being closed this long; conversations stay.

actions.title: Actions

default.prompt:
Translate the text below to {language}. If it already is {language}, translate it to Spanish. Reply with the translation only, keeping formatting.

{selection}

Explain the following clearly and briefly:

{selection}

Rewrite the text below to be clearer and more natural, same language and meaning. Reply with the rewritten text only.

{selection}

Fix bugs and obvious mistakes in this code. Reply with the corrected code only, no fences, no commentary.

{selection}

Explain this error and how to fix it, briefly:

{clipboard}

default.name: Commit message

Write a conventional commit message for this diff:

{clipboard}

messageStyle.title: Your messages
messageStyle.description: Bubbles on the right, or flat blocks like the answers.

fontScale.description: Scale of the conversation text relative to the theme font size.

showAvatars.title: Avatars
showAvatars.description: Show a small avatar next to your messages and the answers.

showTimestamps.title: Timestamps
showTimestamps.description: Show the time under each message.

animations.description: Animate size changes, the space switch and new messages.

suggestions.title: Suggestions

thinkingExpanded.title: Expand thinking

collapseTools.title: Collapse tool details
collapseTools.description: Show tool calls as one line; expand a row to see its input and output.

strip.title: Strip
strip.description: Items of the status strip above the AI bar composer.

engine.title: Engine and model
engine.description: Engine, model and reasoning effort; click it to switch.

context.title: Context window
context.description: How much of the model's context the conversation uses.
